Complete the program and earn a Season Pass to keep exploring Powder Mountain on your own. No gear, no problem. Rentals are included during your three lessons and for the remainder of the season.

Here’s how it works:
1️⃣ Sign up for Powder Pathway at the link in bio ➡️ @powdermountain 
2️⃣ Build your skills from the ground up with a Ski & Ride School Pro during three group lessons.
3️⃣ Complete all three lessons, unlock your Season Pass & daily rentals for the rest of the season.

body:
Some places you visit. Some places you become part of.

Revelstoke is a mountain in the making: North America’s longest lift-served vertical at 1,713 m, an average of 10.5 m of snow a year, and a real mountain town at its base. 

Winters are for deep powder. Summers are for bike trails, alpine adventure and long evenings downtown. 

Watch the series, then find your place on the mountain.

The Peak Pass is back again with some awesome savings and Free Skiing!

Check out what the Alyeska Peak Pass has in store for your winter:

🎁 Free early-season skiing. Score your Peak Pass before 12/4/26 and ski FREE from December 4th - December 14th.
